evidence.exact_span: Due primarily to the Company's history of operating losses, management is unable to conclude that it is more likely than not that the Company will realize the benefits of these deductible differences, and accordingly has provided a valuation allowance against the entire net deferred tax assets and liabilities of approximately $54.4 million at December 31, 2022, reflecting an increase of approximately $2.3 million from December 31, 2021.
